svg.title: Site plan, main hub
svg.desc: Herdade da Granja, main hub. Existing buildings traced from the professional survey of the main house (October 2021); planned items from José María's masterplan, dashed, concept. Norfront, 6 November 2026.

g.text: Solid, hatched: the buildings as they stand, traced from the professional survey
of the main house (October 2021): the events hall,
the house wing and the pool court, and Monte da Horta across the farm road.
Every surveyed building is single storey (hall eaves 4.61 m).
Dashed: José María's masterplan concept, labelled planned. The lobby, restaurant
and housekeeping cluster in the west has no survey; its outline is the concept's.
Existing outlines: true scale, north up, placed on the masterplan by the hall.
Existing building, from the survey (roof outline)
Roads, walls, pool and trees, from the survey
True scale. Existing outlines placed north-up, anchored on the hall
